regulatory.title: Adapting to a Shifting Regulatory Landscape
regulatory.subtitle: Regulations Are Rising

insights.text: Over 50,000 companies worldwide are required to disclose detailed ESG data under the EU's Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive.
51% of board directors believe their boards are adequately prepared to oversee upcoming ESG disclosure mandates — up from just 25% in 2022.
46% of consumers report purchasing more sustainable products to reduce their carbon footprint.
Despite concerns around the cost of living, consumers are willing to pay an average of 9.7% more for sustainably sourced or produced goods.
Circular economy practices could reduce global CO2 emissions by 39% by 2030.
With circular economy principles in place, up to 80% of global plastic waste could be recycled by 2040.

finance.title: Economic Impact: Sustainable Finance & ESG Assets
finance.subtitle: Sustainable Finance Is Growing

insights.text: Global sustainable finance assets reached $35.3 trillion in 2020, representing 36% of total managed assets.
ESG-focused funds attracted $51.1 billion in net flows in 2020, a 96% increase from 2019.
